## Checklist

- [ ] New or changed setting / command — documented in `docs/SETTINGS.md` **and** all three READMEs
      (`README.md`, `README.ja.md`, `README.zh.md`)
- [ ] New UI text — translated in `l10n/bundle.l10n.*.json` (and `package.nls.*.json` for contributions)
- [ ] UI changed — screenshots regenerated with `npm run screenshots`
- [ ] Behaviour changed — the matching spec in `docs/` updated
- [ ] No extra API calls while Claude Code is idle (at most once per 5 minutes)
